status: PROPOSED supported-environment record v2 for OCS-MVP-QGATE-05 (the single authorized hosted run). Pending Qualification-owner acceptance and freeze as part of commitment v5. NOT production configuration. Non-authorizing; no independence, certification, Q7 or Tier 1 claim. environment-profile.proposed.v1.json stays byte-identical (it is what commitment v4 committed); this file is a NEW versioned file.
supersedes: process/mvp-acceptance/environment-profile.proposed.v1.json (not edited). What changed from v1, and nothing else: (1) the IPC directory mode 2751 is annotated as the BOUNDED SYNTHETIC TEST profile ratified by Architect D3 (not production); (2) Yama is recorded as found and is no longer set by the workflow (no sysctl); (3) the host is pinned to ubuntu-24.04 and the NC4 state tree base path to /var/lib/qgate05-ocs/tmp (avoids the ACL FAIL under /opt); (4) the trigger, custody and evidence channel are described. Required check ids, capture-script pin, identities, 0660 socket and journal mode are unchanged from v1.
profile: restricted Linux, single host, CPython 3.13, pydantic >= 2.12

host.runner: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 (never ubuntu-latest); image identity (ImageOS, ImageVersion) and kernel are recorded in the run (run-identity.json, host-evidence/)
host.base_path: /var/lib/qgate05-ocs (root:root 0755, must not pre-exist); the suite's TMPDIR is /var/lib/qgate05-ocs/tmp so tempfile.mkdtemp creates the NC4 state tree there. Never /tmp (sticky, other-writable) and never /opt (the ACL FAIL seen in QGATE-02/03). Durable writable store for the real-kill test: /var/lib/qgate05-ocs/durable (QG5_DURABLE_DIR).
host.sandbox: none: plain VM, passwordless sudo, no container or seccomp profile on the test processes, so a test may SIGKILL its own child (Architect A1)
host.host_changes: throwaway groups/users mvp-ingress, mvp-client, mvp-ipc; read access (go+rX,go-w) on the workspace and go+x on its ancestors so the ingress uid can read the pinned checkouts; NO sysctl, NO Yama change, NO ACL change
host.trigger: push to branch qgate-05/run-1 only, run_attempt == 1, no re-run path; commitment sha256 and qualification revision come from the hub custody record docs/mvp-recovery/qgate-05/custody/freeze-commitment.json (default branch), never from the candidate checkout

python.note: A Python 3.12 result is supplementary and cannot qualify this profile. This workflow does not change main's mvp-chain.yml.

yama.absent: Yama unavailable means the exact profile is unsupported: the boundary test is BLOCKED and the verdict is INCOMPLETE; no weaker environment is substituted.
yama.as_found: Recorded as found on the hosted runner (QGATE-03 run 41153041401 passed isolation.ptrace_scope on ubuntu-24.04); the workflow does NOT set it. A value below 1 leaves the boundary test BLOCKED and the verdict INCOMPLETE.

hub_record.producer: tools/mvp_env_record/capture_env_record.py (hub PR #219, branch mvp-ingress-env-record, head 3fff3dfb0fb909774cdae77557689dde4cb90f12; script bytes identical to 050dcd67 and 0e2b52a0)
hub_record.refresh: Environment evidence must be refreshed (a new record) if the execution host or a relevant setting changes.

ipc.separate_ipc_directory: the socket's directory must not be, or sit under, the ingress state directory; it is owned by the ingress uid, setgid group mvp-ipc, mode 2751: not group/other writable (the hub check ipc.directory_separate_and_protected only refuses group/other write) and with other SEARCH (x) only, no read, so the outsider uid can traverse it and is denied by the socket's own 0660 mode and group, which qualification.outsider_denied_socket then proves (hub untraversable_for logic)
ipc.test_profile_annotation: BOUNDED SYNTHETIC TEST CONFIGURATION ONLY (Architect D3, ratified 2026-10-30): IPC directory mode 2751, socket mode 0660, peer-UID allowlist (--allow-uid), synthetic data, throwaway accounts on an ephemeral runner. The historical 2750 evidence (QGATE-03 primary record, outsider socket check BLOCKED) is preserved and is not rewritten. NOT a production setting and not a recommendation for one. Accepted residual: an outsider uid can stat a known socket name in the IPC directory; no directory listing, socket connection or state-content disclosure is authorized or observed. If later evidence contradicts this confinement, revert the test profile to 2750 and mark the socket-level outsider control BLOCKED.
ipc.created_by: suites/mvp-chain/_ingress.py (mkdir under tempfile.mkdtemp base, chown ingress uid : mvp-ipc gid, chmod 2751); the run records its stat in the environment record and the suite observations

hub_record.run_binding: The hub record is deterministic and carries no run id. The envelope (cognous.mvp-environment-record-envelope/1) carries run_id and qualification_sha supplied by the workflow (MVP_RUN_ID, MVP_QUALIFICATION_SHA), the record's own record_sha256, the sha256 of the record file, the sha256 of the capture script and of this profile; the gate requires all of them to match. Missing run_id or qualification_sha is INCOMPLETE, a different one FAIL.
hub_record.source_binding: configuration.ingress_source_sha256 must equal the sha256 of tools/mvp_ingress/*.py in the hub checkout at the tuple sha; absent is INCOMPLETE. Each component pin in the record must equal the tuple sha of that component.
hub_record.interpreter_binding: python.version must equal the interpreter version the suite observed in this run
hub_record.required_ids_note: Reconciled against the ids the hub script at the pinned sha256 emits (also verified by running it: 32 ids on a bare host, of which the always-emitted PASS-or-better set is required). Not required by name: capture.exception, <section>.exception, filesystem.state_dir_present and filesystem.socket_present (BLOCKED markers emitted only on failure; any BLOCKED check already makes the verdict INCOMPLETE). A required id absent from the record is INCOMPLETE; one that is not PASS is INCOMPLETE (BLOCKED) or FAIL.

capture_script.hub_pr: cogno-us/cognous-open-control-stack#219 head 3fff3dfb0fb909774cdae77557689dde4cb90f12 (script moved out of the ingress package; bytes identical to the approved 050dcd670ff23faf0a5e33d3bd6cb0db5e65c74e and the test-only follow-up 0e2b52a0; sha256 computed from the file)
capture_script.note: RE-PINNED to the script bytes at hub main 330ccc31 (hub PR #230); they differ from the earlier 5ae7beca/050dcd67 bytes, so the earlier statements about identical bytes describe the superseded pin. Pinned because the hub script is still moving. The script in the hub checkout at the tuple sha must have exactly these bytes (a different script is a NEW candidate: new profile version and commitment), and the run envelope must name this sha256. The candidate-identity hub sha (hub main) predates the script: a run needs hub_revision set to a sha that contains it, otherwise G-11 is INCOMPLETE.
capture_script.forbidden_note: The capture script must NOT sit inside the ingress package: if it is present at this old path in the hub checkout at the tuple sha, preflight-hub and G-11 fail (the ingress tree digest the NC4-03 pins bind to must not carry it).

manifest.note: manifest file passed to the capture script; its sha256 must equal the record's configuration.manifest_sha256 (checked against the tuple's action-manifest checkout)

identities.note: dedicated users and group created by the workflow; names only, the uids and gids are resolved on the host and compared with the record. The ingress runs as mvp-ingress (non-root, own primary group), the client as mvp-client, the socket group mvp-ipc has exactly those two members.

provisioning.yama: recorded as found (cat /proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope); NOT set by the workflow. Absent or < 1 is BLOCKED and the verdict INCOMPLETE
provisioning.ipc_directory: a separate directory (setgid, group mvp-ipc, 2751: traverse-only for others; BOUNDED SYNTHETIC TEST profile, not production) the client and the outsider probe can traverse; the ingress-owned 0700 state directory is never the socket directory; both live under /var/lib/qgate05-ocs/tmp/mvp-nc4-*
provisioning.socket: 0660, owner the ingress uid, group mvp-ipc
provisioning.developer_optout: MVP_INGRESS_PROFILE=developer-optout (local only: root ingress, mode 666, uid 65534, no record); the suite records profile=developer-optout and the gate verdict is INCOMPLETE. The workflow always sets MVP_INGRESS_PROFILE=approved.
provisioning.base_path: TMPDIR=/var/lib/qgate05-ocs/tmp for the chain group so the state tree and its ancestors (/var/lib/qgate05-ocs, /var/lib, /var, /) are root-owned, not other-writable and ACL-free

hub_record.capture: captured IN THE RUN by suites/mvp-chain/_ingress.py as root against the very ingress process the suite then attacks (not a pre-committed file); written to mvp-chain/artifacts/environment-record.json with a gate-side envelope environment-record.envelope.json
hub_record.independent_pin: There is no pre-committed environment record hash any more: the independent anchor is the pin on the capture script (above) plus the candidate commitment, which covers this profile.
hub_record.identity_binding: the identities the suite observed on the running ingress and client (uid, gid, ipc gid, non-root) must equal process_identity and ipc.stat in the record
hub_record.optional_note: Emitted by the hub script only when the outsider was denied at the IPC directory (not at the socket). It is informational and never substitutes for qualification.outsider_denied_socket, which must be PASS; its presence is INCOMPLETE because the socket's own mode/group was then not tested.

evidence_label.note: passed as --label by the suite; missing or blank makes capture.evidence_label BLOCKED (INCOMPLETE); the gate also requires the record's evidence_label to carry this run's run_id and profile=approved
